text:
on loyalty & friendship >>

"A friend is someone who walks in when the rest of the world walks out." Walter Winchill

I really think the best/simplest way to think about a friendship is as an obligation

phone rings > on next flight. period.

thats what a friend is. 

--

(1/4)

if 50 said "yup next flight, got u always," 40 will perform a magic trick

*poof* into thin air - right when u need em most.

THE PRESTIGE!

thru this lens... you dont have capacity for many friends.

5-10? can't be much more.

(2/4)

the other 1000+ "people you know" -- those are acquaintances, not friends.

its good to have both...but do not ever confuse the two.

all the other bullshit like talking news/mkts/sports etc...u dont need that from a friend.

loyal friendship is no pleasantries or nonsense or small talk. if u got news, hit me. no need for forced catchups.

"yo, so hows work going man?!?!?!" - that intonation lol...either plotting on ur girl or wearing a wire

mf hittin them high notes like sal "big pussy" bonpensiero

(3/4)

hard part + in process

all "acquaintance" groupchats, obligations, social events...waste of time, fluff.

the true obligation is loyal friendship

outside that circle, ur leaking precious time to flimsy relationships...about as reliable as the Hormuz Business Hours on Google Maps.

social obligations is hard; searching for magic answer which = (no + truthful + doesnt offend).

"idk, I might be in rehab that day" checks all 3

if they sound skeptical, start rambling about how u are "sooooo dopesick without my oxy's"

just like that... *poof* 

"I gotta go"

hugh jackman and christian bale star in...

*whispering* the prestige

(4/4)

thats all u need.

find those 5-10 people who you will take bullets for, and who would take bullets for you.

THOSE are friends. 

the tricky part is that u rarely know who those 5-10 are, until the bullets start flying.

if u have those people in your life, show gratitude, let them know they're appreciated.

loyalty is exceptionally rare, and most people u will meet on this earth will go through their entire life without ever having made a single true friend.

if u got em, grip 'em tight

"iron sharpens iron, as one man sharpens another" ⚔️
